new_repository_result: The active JANUS chain now has a fully replayable bottom-up vtree compiler for affine factors, including charged decomposition construction, exact symbolic projection at every node, merge/separator operations, SAT witness recovery, and UNSAT XOR provenance without truth-table enumeration.
